### 4. WebKit IP and DNS leaks defeat proxy browsers and iCloud Private Relay

- Source: [mysk.blog](https://mysk.blog/2026/08/04/webkit-proxy-icloud-private-relay-ip-leak/)
- Category: AI Operations / Agent Control
- Published: 2026-08-06T00:00:00.000Z
- Labels: reproducible, publish_public
- Product relevance: none

Source facts:
- Three WebKit features — DNS prefetching, WebAuthn Related Origin Requests, and WebTransport — bypass configured proxies on iOS and macOS, leaking real IP and DNS data even through iCloud Private Relay.

Builder/operator takeaway: Concrete, reproduced privacy failure affecting every iOS browser and anyone building iOS apps that rely on proxy assumptions.

Uncertainty: No confirmed Apple fix timeline; only the third-party Psylo browser has patched (1.3.1) so far.
